info.title: Local Supermarket Marketplace API
info.description: REST API for the Angular frontoffice. It supports client authentication, supermarket browsing, product search, price comparison, coupon validation, order management, Stripe payments, reviews and client dashboard statistics.

tags.name: Reviews
tags.description: Client reviews for supermarkets and couriers

JWT.name: x-access-token
JWT.description: JWT token returned by the login endpoint

get.summary: Check if the REST API is running
Get dashboard statistics for the authenticated client

post.summary: Validate and calculate a coupon before creating an order
post.description: Validates a coupon using the current cart, delivery method and supermarket inferred from the products. The cart must contain products from one supermarket only.

parameters.name: couponData
parameters.description: Cart, delivery method and coupon code to validate

400.description: Invalid cart, delivery method or coupon

post.summary: Create a new order for the authenticated client
post.description: Creates a new order. The order can only contain products from one supermarket. Optional couponCode and paymentMethod are supported.

get.summary: List orders created by the authenticated client

post.summary: Cancel one order created by the authenticated client

get.summary: Get one order created by the authenticated client
Get the authenticated client's review for a delivered order
get.description: Only delivered orders can be reviewed.

200.description: Current review state for the order

400.description: Invalid order ID or order is not delivered

put.summary: Create or update the authenticated client's review for a delivered order
put.description: The supermarket rating is required. Courier rating is optional and only allowed when the order had a delivered courier.

parameters.name: reviewData
parameters.description: Review data for the supermarket and optionally the courier

400.description: Invalid review data, invalid order ID or order is not delivered

get.summary: Compare prices for the same product across approved supermarkets
List available products from approved supermarkets

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional supermarket name or location search

get.summary: List available products from one approved supermarket
List public reviews for one approved supermarket

200.description: Supermarket review statistics and latest reviews

post.summary: Create a Stripe Checkout Session for an authenticated client order
post.description: The order must belong to the authenticated client, use paymentMethod=stripe, not be cancelled and not already be paid.

parameters.name: paymentData
parameters.description: Order to pay through Stripe Checkout

400.description: Invalid order ID, order cannot be paid with Stripe, already paid or cancelled

post.summary: Confirm a Stripe Checkout Session after the client returns to the site

400.description: Missing or invalid Stripe session ID

404.description: Order not found for this Stripe session

couponCode.description: Optional coupon code. It is normalized to uppercase by the API.
